entries.why: Treant Bark XP Item: its item is an Atlas-package XP item (drop audit grade REMOVE), the only Allakhazam page (cquest 3031, giver Milo, not Paud) was created after Catacombs pages (cquest 2673) with no comment before 2008, and the giver Paud is a hostile realm-0 monster: no period evidence, so the offer is retired instead of restoring a freeshard drop
